Also...is it just me or does the little symbol that appears after the #MeToo hashtag look like an angry vagina? 

I'm not opposed to vaginas (obvs.), but I don't think it 'works' for the hashtag. (though I think The Angry Vaginas is a great name for my future punk band). https://t.co/o9dQWop94t

Everyone will win when white supremacy is vanquished. White people need to stop feeling threatened and killing to hold onto power. We’re living in a constant state of insecurity and scarcity, but a better world is one in which there is abundance for all. #BlackLivesMatter

Prediction: This amazing photo by @graciejensn will become one of the iconic photos of 2020. It captures multiple zeitgeists all at once: #covid19 #BlackLivesMatter and the bravery of black people in the face of white supremacy + anti-black racism. I can’t stop thinking about it. https://t.co/ynwRcRKrwx
